text:
sheraz: proposing soft-unpin of runtime -> 3.5.0 for longseq canary. target model: llama3q. change window: 2026-03-20 12:00-14:00PT. reason: fixes to kv eviction + attention kernel perf for >4k tokens.

luke: agree soft-unpin. plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% over ~90m with QA gates. keep quant-heavy pools pinned to 3.4.1.

tina: add explicit rollback criteria pls: p95 increase > 25% OR error rate > 1% OR kv_miss_rate jumps > 0.15 absolute. also ensure sdk shim >=1.2.1 for streaming patch.

robin: confirm how we'll roll traffic. canary-routing policy exists?

sheraz: yes, will deploy routing change via routing-config canary-route-llama3q. initial cohort: 3 hosts. command: `rb runtime unpin --runtime 3.5.0 --cohort canary-A --mode soft`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiating canary rollout: cohort A (3 hosts) -> runtime 3.5.0. preflight checks running.

ops-watch: ops-watch: added dashboard panels + alert `canary.runtime.regression` set to page oncall if triggered. watch panels: kv_miss_rate, gen_latency_p50/p95, error_rate, seq_throughput.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight results: healthchecks=pass (9/9), kvcache_miss=0.09, p50=70ms, p95=215ms. proceeding to expand to 8 hosts in 12m. :hourglass:

elaine: add post-rollout eval using `evals/longseq_smoketest.json`. schedule manual QA at 25% expansion for 30m. if regressions >0.015 (NPL), trigger rollback.

luke: noted. I'll hold on full unpin until QA thumbs-up. tagging @oncall for visibility.

robin: quick note: older SDK clients (1.1.x) can fallback but have streaming truncation bug. recommend sending a release note asking clients to upgrade.

tina: release notes blurb: "Runtime 3.5.0 soft-unpin for llama3q to improve long sequence throughput. Customers using SDK <=1.1.x should upgrade to 1.2.1 to avoid streaming truncation. Change window: 12:00-14:00PT."

sheraz: preflight additional check -> run `./scripts/compare_npl.sh regressions/common_longseq.json`. threshold 0.015.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: expanded to 8 hosts. monitoring: kv_miss=0.11, p95=230ms, errors=0.002. no alerts yet.

ops-watch: ops-watch: alert rule live: `increase(rate(canary_runtime_errors[5m])) > 3` -> page. also added synthetic ping every 30s to canary hosts.

elaine: hitting the 25% pause. starting manual QA now. please hold further expansion until QA OK.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: paused at 25% per QA hold.

tina: QA notes: small perf variance but NPL delta=0.008, kvcache_miss jitter <0.02. OK to continue.

luke: continuing rollout to 60% over next 30m. remember revert steps: 1) `rb runtime --pin 3.4.1 --reason \"rollback - runtime perf regression\"` 2) update routing-config to route back 100% to 3.4.1 3) run `redis-cli -h prefix-cache del prefix:*` to clear canary prefixes 4) upload rollback note to changelog and status page.

sheraz: running final preflight before 60%: `./scripts/canary_healthcheck.sh --model llama3q --seq 8192`. will abort if checksum mismatch or eval delta >0.015.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: expanded to 60%. monitoring: kv_miss=0.13, p95=245ms, errors=0.003. no alert fired.

ops-watch: ops-watch: keeping watch. will page if p95 > 320ms OR errors rate spikes > 1.5x baseline.

elaine: scheduling post-rollout regression eval to run on saved promptset and will attach report to release doc.

tina: updating release doc with runbook + rollback snippets and change window. adding note to engineering-changelog.

oncall: oncall: copied runbook and will monitor the alert channel. ping me if we hit pages.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete to 100%. final metrics: kv_miss=0.12, p50=72ms, p95=255ms, errors=0.0032. post-rollout eval queued. :white_check_mark:

elaine: post-rollout eval finished: NPL delta=0.009, no significant regressions. closing window.

sheraz: updating pinned runtime policy: soft-unpin slot removed. leaving runtime 3.5.0 active for general pools. will open a follow-up for quant pool review next week.

robin: added release-note entry and customer advisory for SDK upgrade.

luke: great work. documenting lessons learned: add an automated check for SDK client versions in incoming requests to avoid silent streaming issues in future.

sheraz: thanks team. I'll archive the canary logs and attach to the release thread.
